# pvecli backup remove

Delete backups. A protected backup is never deleted (unprotect it first).

```text
pvecli backup remove VOLIDS [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VOLIDS` | Backup volume(s) to delete. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--node VALUE` | Node to go through (default: the node holding the backup). |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
